Introduction

This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, 
which must be performed 
every 12000 operation hours as indicated by H 
12000 in the above title block.

The
fuel natural gas piping to supply the fuel to 
the fuel nozzles of GT frame 5

The 
first draft initiated and prepared by eng. Ehab Mohammed Moustafa and revised by 
inspection and quality control at EDEPC eng. Abouda Elbanna and tested by eng. 
Mahmoud Abd Elhady, accepted by general director eng. Yosry Ahmed Abd El Maqsood and 
approved by eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab; head sector of Talkha power station.

This document accepted by eng. Samir Abdel Gilil; EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin. & financial inspection, and quality control general director and 
supervisor of inspection & quality control head sector.
Safety Precautions

items:
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff 
 should carry the suitable safety category.

Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area 
 is required.

Wear the safety and 
 healthy equipment as safety 
 helmet, safety shoes, earplug, and gloves pairs...etc
Unit out of service.

Fire fighting system 
 should be isolated.

Fuel system should be 
 isolated.

Oil system should be 
 isolated.

All switches in motor 
 control center MCC panel should be isolated.

sections.text: Tools and Equipment

items: Complete maintenance tool set.
Safety and healthy equipment.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out
Remove one fuel gas piping.

Remove fuel gas nozzle and blank out let ends of 
gas manifold pigtails with blind flanges.

Blank off inlet to gas strainer using a flange 
drilled and tapped in its center for 1/ 4 inch.

Connect 1/ 4 inch tubing from a single ( 0 500 
PSI ) range pressure regulator to the tapped hole in the flange installed on 
the fuel gas manifold.
Provide a source of clean and dry air pressure.

Remove the three pressure gages from the gas 
stop/control valve and plug the connections also disconnect the pressure switch 
and plug the connection.

Open pressure regulator and raise pressure in 
piping to 280 PSI.

Soap suds all flanged, screwed and welded 
connections and joints and inspect for leaks.

After all leaks have been corrects, gradually 
raise test pressure to 350 Psi and hold for 10 minutes, if no leaks develop, 
increase test pressure to 400 PSI hold the system for 3 to 5 minutes

At the test pressure of 400 Psi soap suds all 
joints fittings and welds and re-inspect for leaks.

Remove blanking flanges and reconnect gauges and 
pressure switch.
Install fuel gas nozzle.
